sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: A significant update in Qwen2.5 is the reintroduction of our 14B and 32B models, Qwen2.5-14B and Qwen2.5-32B. These models outperform baseline models of comparable or larger sizes, such as Phi-3.5-MoE-Instruct and Gemma2-27B-IT, across diverse tasks.

sources.snippet: Why This Exists Most AI platforms trade your data for convenience. They track, filter, and restrict. Venice flips the script: your prompts stay local, your ideas aren't policed, and you get fast, unfiltered responses without the corporate overhead.
